_about: Committed IGT datasets (test-data/igt/<name>/). 'set' overrides vehicle.json keys; 'tune' rescales the motor impulse (measured curve shape) to an apogee; 'motor_from' reuses another variant's tuned impulse; 'glitches' are injected sensor faults (see sensors.py). Order matters: a variant's motor_from must come earlier.

variants.name: nominal_10k
variants.description: nominal flight to 10,000 ft (measured curve shape, scaled impulse)

variants.name: measured_motor
variants.description: the 2026-11-16 measured motor, unscaled, on the assumed airframe

variants.name: high_wind
variants.description: nominal motor in 9 m/s (20 mph, the SA Cup launch limit) wind with 3 m/s gusts

variants.name: early_apogee_noise
variants.description: Kalman stress: noisy baro, large Mach/port error, outliers, a false-descent pressure step before apogee, big ejection spikes
variants.notes: baro raw noise 6 Pa (3x), static-port Cp -0.03 subsonic / -0.12 transonic (reads high during boost), 1200 Pa ejection pulses (about -110 m at the drogue), plus:

variants.name: off_nominal
variants.description: FC logic: late/hard main (opens at 300 m), IMU saturation glitch, baro freeze, GPS dropout and jump
variants.notes: the main physically opens at 300 m instead of 457 m (the FC still commands it at 457 m; the data keeps the drogue rate down to 300 m), with a harder opening, plus:
